query.raw: Our Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL reader endpoint misses writes that are already visible on the writer endpoint, even though there was no failover. What should we check first?
Two etcd clients both think they hold the same lock after a short lease TTL, and updates to the protected external set are lost. What should we check first?
In RavenDB single-node transactions, two sessions both read the same version and both commit appends, but one write disappears while optimistic concurrency is off. What should we check first?
In MySQL 8.0 Repeatable Read, two transactions both read a missing key and append the first value, but one update disappears. What should we check first?
In a CockroachDB monotonic test, cross-range transactions sometimes create duplicate writes with the same timestamp while clock offset stays below the threshold. What should we check first?
